subject: One of England's most famous trees, the Major Oak in Sherwood Forest, has died after standing for more than a millennium

A millennium of history ends in Sherwood Forest. The Major Oak has succumbed to the pressures of a changing world.

The Major Oak, a 1,000-year-old tree in Sherwood Forest, has died after failing to produce leaves this spring, with experts citing climate change and soil compaction as key factors.
